summary: Gameplay Doctor feature validated end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass (POST admin, GET latest before+after, free-user gating 402, pro-user-no-telemetry 400, diagnose regression, diagnose gating). Frontend flow verified on live preview: card visible with prior report, Analyze click generates new AI report in ~25-30s, score/issues/tweak badges all render correctly.

issues: Cookies & Privacy banner overlaps the last Gameplay Doctor issue card at bottom — pre-existing but worth a padding-bottom on the page container so the last issue isn't hidden. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: advisor.py::gameplay_doctor persists {..., '_id':...} then pops '_id'. Because insert_one mutates the dict in-place adding _id, the pop is required; correct but subtle. OK.
GameplayDoctor.jsx uses issue.severity as key for SEV map — good; consider defaulting when severity is uppercase from LLM (currently AI returns lowercase 'high'/'medium'/'low' per prompt, verified).

The i18n language passed to the endpoint is i18n.language which can be 'en' even on IT UI; the AI report language then diverges from the UI labels. Not a bug per se but user might see mixed IT/EN if they toggle. Consider forcing UI-selected lang.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates temp free user + temp pro user (via DB plan bump on freshly registered account) for gating and no-telemetry edge cases. Both cleaned up on teardown. Admin telemetry NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_gameplay_doctor.py. Uses pymongo directly (test_database DB) to promote registered starter user to pro (plan=streamer + subscription_expires_at in future) to test /api/advisor/gameplay-doctor no-telemetry 400 branch. Consumed 3 AI calls (2x gameplay-doctor + 1x diagnose regression) — well within 100/hour admin cap.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found. The helpers.py fix (startup entries treated as dict) is exercised implicitly by the diagnose regression test (admin has 7 startup programs and diagnose returns 200).
